title: Is she your mom?
grammar: Possessive adjectives; Possessive 's and s'; Verb be: yes/no questions; Questions with Who and What
pair_game: Say a family word. Your partner points at the right picture. Then swap!

grammar_box.title: My, your, his, her + ’s
rows: Who is she? She’s my aunt.
grammar_box.tip: ’s = belongs to: Madina’s mom = Madinaning onasi

questions: Who is in your family? How many people are there?
What is your mother's name? What does she do?
Is your family big or small? Tell me about your brothers and sisters.
Who is your favorite person in your family? Why do you like them?
What is your father's job? Is he busy every day?
Do you have grandparents? What are their names?
Is your family home big or small? Who lives there with you?
What does your family do together on weekends?
Who is the funniest person in your family?
What is something special or unique about your family?
starters: My family is … . There are … people.
My mother’s name is … . She’s a …
My family is … . I have … brother(s) and … sister(s).
My favourite person is my … . I like her / him because …
My father is a … . Yes, he is. / No, he isn’t.
Yes, I do. Their names are … and …
Our home is … . My … live(s) with me.
The funniest person is my … . He / She …
samples: Who is in your family? How many people are there?
There are **five** people in my family. **My** mom, **my** dad, **my** brother, **my** sister and me!
What is your mother's name? What does she do?
**My mother’s** name is Dilnoza. She is a teacher.
Who is the funniest person in your family?
**My grandpa** is the funniest! **His** jokes are very funny.

survey.title: Class survey
survey.question: How many people are in your family?

game.title: Roll and talk
game.rules: Roll the dice. Look at the number. Talk about your family for 30 seconds!
items: 3 — Talk about your brother or sister.
4 — Talk about your grandma or grandpa.
5 — Who is the funniest in your family?
6 — What does your family do on Sunday?

mini_talk.title: My family
plan: Say how many people are in your family
Say one thing about each person
mini_talk.model: Hi! There are six people in **my** family. **My** dad’s name is Rustam. **He’s** a doctor. **My** mom’s name is Nodira. **She’s** a teacher. **My** sister is Laylo and **my** brother is Ali. **My** grandma lives with us. **Her** plov is great! On Sundays we go to the park together.

cando: name the people in my family
use my, your, his, her and ’s
ask Who and What questions about a family
